messages:
tay: SI partner asked for an official certificate rotation pattern for OTLP collectors on air-gapped marketplace appliances. Needs offline signing workflow, TTL guidance, and a revocation path that works without outbound access. Can we draft a README and scripts?

nina: Key constraints: no secrets shipped, rotation via signed CSR transferred by operator (USB/sftp), local cert watch path, atomic swap script, clear rollback. Recommend TTL default 90 days, allow up to 365.

prashant: I'll prototype rotate.sh that validates key perms, performs checksum, writes new cert to /etc/telemetry/certs/, and sends SIGHUP to collector. Will include a dry-run flag. Opening PR in infra-extras when ready.

lisa: Marketplace docs need privacy wording: traces opt-in (telemetry.enable_traces=false by default); metrics enabled by default but all labels must be redactable. Legal wants example non-PII labels and guidance on hashing user ids.

dd-integ-bot: Datadog partner guide updated with offline-cert patterns v1.2. Internal link: https://internal.datadog/partners/ri-offline-cert. Added tag mapping and recommended span prefixes.

tay: For revocation, propose a signed revocation manifest placed at /etc/telemetry/revocations.json; collector checks at startup and on rotation. Note: partner ingestion jobs must ignore revoked certs when pulling file exports.

nina: Sample collector snippet for README (traces disabled by default):
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
      http: {}
processors:
  resource:
    attributes:
      - key: service.name
        value: "redwood-hw-agent"
      - key: hw.vendor
        value: ${HW_VENDOR}
exporters:
  file:
    path: /var/log/telemetry/otlp-out.json
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [resource]
      exporters: [file]
# Note: datadog exporter removed in air-gapped bundles; enable traces with telemetry.enable_traces=true
```

prashant: Test plan: 1) simulate offline rotate with signed CSR and ensure collector reloads without dropping spans; 2) apply revoked manifest and verify collector rejects revoked cert; 3) perf smoke. I'll run tests Tue 09:30 PT on sim-hw and post artifacts.

lisa: I'll prepare two dashboard tiles (gpu_util, token_throughput) and a trace waterfall tile mapped to the file-export schema. Add metadata: partner:datadog, distribution:marketplace-appliance, privacy:airgap-safe.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Simulation job queued: infra/sim-rotate-run-12. Logs: https://ci.redwood/run/12/logs

tay: Recap: @prashant rotate.sh + tests (Tue 09:30), @nina README + cert pattern doc (PR by EOD Mon), @lisa dashboard + privacy blurb (EOW). Legal to provide final wording. We'll bundle into listing called "Signed-Collector Airgap". Keep updates here.
